sources.summary: Superflux co-founder Anab Jain has been awarded this year's LDF Design Innovation Medal. In this interview, she argues speculative design can still be a source of hope even in dark times. It's yet another 32-degree day in London's alarming summer of 32-degree days, and Jain has been telling her colleagues about her childhood in India. The post "In these conditions, how can we be optimistic?" asks Anab Jain appeared first on Dezeen .
